intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Ao Nang. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Most people stay on Ao Nang Beach — central, walkable to restaurants and the pier for island tours. For quiet pick Nopparat Thara at the west end; for nature and cliffs choose Railay (boat-access, no cars); for quiet luxury head to Klong Muang/Tubkaek in the north.

faq.q: Where in Ao Nang should I stay for a first visit?
faq.a: Ao Nang Beach is best for a first visit — the hub for hotels of all budgets, restaurants and boats to the 4 Islands and Phi Phi, with an easy, walkable beachfront.

faq.q: Railay vs Ao Nang — what is the difference?
faq.a: Ao Nang is more convenient with shops and road access, while Railay is boat-access only — quiet, with gorgeous cliffs, ideal for nature lovers and climbers, though food and supplies cost more there.

faq.q: Which province is Ao Nang in?
faq.a: Ao Nang is a beach area in Krabi province and the main accommodation hub for Krabi visitors, about 30–40 minutes from Krabi Airport.
